meta.scope: Benefits/credits a U.S. household may qualify for, surfaced by state where state-specific. We NEVER invent dollar amounts — only list programs with official eligibility links. Verify your own eligibility with the cited agency.
meta.ymyl: Benefit amounts, income limits, and deadlines change yearly. Always confirm on the official program site before relying on any figure.
sources: LIHEAP / Dept. of Health & Human Services
IRS (EITC, CTC, ACA Premium Tax Credit)

federal.title: Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)
federal.detail: Refundable federal credit for low- to moderate-income workers. Worth up to several thousand dollars depending on income and children.

federal.title: Child Tax Credit (CTC)
federal.detail: Up to $2,000 per qualifying child (2025 rules; confirm current-year amount). Partially refundable.

federal.title: Adoption / education credits
federal.detail: American Opportunity and Lifetime Learning credits for education expenses; Adoption credit.

federal.title: ACA Premium Tax Credit
federal.detail: Subsidies to lower Marketplace health-insurance premiums based on income. Open enrollment typically Nov 1–Jan 15.

federal.title: IRA / Roth IRA contributions
federal.detail: 2026 cap $7,000 ($8,000 age 50+). Tax deduction depends on income and retirement-plan coverage.

federal.title: Health Savings Account
federal.detail: Triple-tax-advantaged if paired with a high-deductible plan. 2026 cap $4,300 single / $8,550 family.
